name: academia-shield
description: Monorepo: Academia Shield web app, production FastAPI backend, and desktop agent tooling

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,agent -c blue,green,yellow "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload" "npm run dev -w @academia-shield/web" "python agent/agent.py"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n api,web,agent -c blue,green,yellow "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload" "npm run dev -w @academia-shield/web" "python agent/agent.py"
